faq.q: What is the difference between copywriting and content writing?
a: Copywriting is written to make someone take an action: request a quote, sign up, buy. Content writing mostly informs or educates. The two work together: we write both, with the same goal of moving your customers one step forward.

Yes. We build search terms and the real questions your customers ask into the copy, with a clear structure and direct answers, so it can be found on Google and quoted by AI assistants without sounding robotic.

faq.q: Can you write in French and in English?
a: Yes. We work in both languages and write for each audience rather than translating word for word.

faq.q: How do you make the copy sound like our brand?
a: We start from your offer, your customers and the words they use, then agree on a tone of voice with you before writing at scale. You review the copy and we refine it until it sounds like you.

faq.q: Do you work with our designers and developers?
a: Yes. Words and layout work best together, so we collaborate with your designers and developers, or with our own [web design](@sites-web) and [landing page](@landing-pages) services.

faq.q: How do you know if the copy works?
a: We agree on a measurable goal before starting, such as inquiries or conversions on a page, and we track it after launch so we can keep improving what matters.
